title: Aerial/Space Combat Tuning and Altitude Assist
description:
Purpose: Layer altitude control aids, horizon lock defaults, and combat-specific parameters when in open-space arenas for hover/flight dogfights.

Behaviour:
- When in orbital_battlefield or oa_defense (scene tags), enable auto-level assist and ensure horizon_lock defaults to on (override allowed in settings).
- Map Right Thumbstick Y to altitude when params.value("right_stick_altitude_mode", true) set; otherwise pitch assist at reduced gain.
- Publish target engagement cues for promoted.ring_construct_core while beaming or placing turrets in zero-G (allow turning during beam).
- Emergency hover: ensure B (Right) triggers quick brake to hover via flight_mode_mechanic.

Quest 3 bindings: none beyond those from flight_mode_mechanic.

Components read/write:
- Reads CFlightState, scene tags, CLocomotionSettings; writes CAerialAssistState, adjusts flight_mode_mechanic control gains via a public API.

Acceptance hooks:
- test_orbital_dogfight: Altitude control on Right Thumbstick (if enabled), boost on Left Stick Click, horizon lock available.

Assets/scenes: orbital_battlefield, oa_defense.
